title: rosa × salaevensis var. lereschei
intro: Rosa × salaevensis var. lereschei, commonly known as Rosa Lereschei, is a type of fragrant and ornamental rose plant. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa Lereschei include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe muscle cramps, reduce swelling, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rosa Lereschei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
